summary: Full backend (18 pytest cases, real GPT-5.5 extraction) + frontend E2E (Playwright, desktop + mobile) of CardPulse. All requested flows work: register (GSTIN validation + uppercase, duplicate mobile/email toasts), WA welcome logged as simulated, admin login/logout, Scan Cards PNG+PDF multi-upload extracts Priya Nair / GREENPOWER SOLAR and logs text + vCard notification, Contacts search/source/added-by filters, drawer edit/save, vCard download, re-send WA, delete, CSV export, Team add/role/deactivate/remove + member 403s, WA simulator text search ('solar companies in haryana') + card attach (source=whatsapp) + greeting help, Settings profile/org save persists, WA panel SIMULATION + webhook URL (verify token only for platform owner), webhook GET verify/403 and POST inbound for registered and unknown numbers, tenant isolation (404s), Google session -> /onboarding -> org completion. The only real bug: brute-force lockout does not work behind the ingress.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout does not work. The identifier is request.client.host + email, but behind K8s ingress client.host is the ingress pod IP, and that changes between requests (seen 10.79.138.2 and 10.79.138.5). Failed attempts get split across several counters, so after 6 wrong passwords the response is still 401 instead of 429. Fix: take the first IP from the X-Forwarded-For header (fall back to client.host), or lock per email only.

minor.issue: Password has no minimum length. password '1' was accepted, unlike register and add-member, which require at least 6 characters.
Empty or whitespace org_name, name and address are accepted (registered an org with org_name='' and name=''; PUT /org name='   ' was saved as ''). Add Pydantic min_length or strip-and-check.
Org mobile is not validated (the ensure-length check is skipped).

No duplicate detection. Scanning the same card again creates another contact and sends another WhatsApp notification to the same person, so they can be spammed. Consider deduping on org_id+mobile/email.
An admin can demote or deactivate the other admins. Only demoting yourself is blocked, so nothing guarantees at least one active admin remains (low risk).

issues: Sonner toasts cover the page header action buttons (Add member, Open simulator) and the contact drawer close (X) button / 'Added by' line for several seconds. Error toasts stay on screen after navigating from /register to /app. Consider bottom-right position or a shorter duration.

action_items: Fix login brute-force identifier to use X-Forwarded-For first IP (or email-only) so the lockout triggers after 5 failures
Add min-length 6 password validation on PATCH /api/team/{id}
Reject blank org_name/name/address in register/onboard/org update
Optional: dedupe contacts on re-scan to avoid duplicate rows and repeat WA notifications
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 591 lines. It is under 700 but close; consider splitting routes (auth/team/contacts/wa) into routers
pipeline.search_contacts loads up to 5000 contacts per query into memory and scores them in Python. This won't scale; use a Mongo text index or a $regex $or query
export CSV does not escape formula-leading cells (=,+,-,@), so CSV injection is possible from AI-extracted text
login_attempts keyed by proxy IP (see critical issue)

process_inbound looks the user up by exact 'from' digits. That works for Meta wa_id format, but a user saved with another country code format would not match (normalize_phone defaults to 91 for 10-digit numbers only)
test_credentials: Admin ceo@smartitbox.in / CardPulse@2026 works; bcrypt $2b$ hash, httpOnly secure cookies confirmed.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ orgs/users (mobiles 919999xxxxxx), contacts, wa_messages, sessions and upload files were created during testing and all cleaned up. DB now has only the seeded admin + SmartITBox org.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0' (xdist is installed; parallel workers break the module-scoped fixtures and cleanup). The test file auto-cleans TEST_ data via direct pymongo (mongodb://localhost:27017, test_database). AI scan takes ~5-10s. Voice note (Whisper) was NOT tested.
rca of the issue: Lockout: server.py login() uses ident=f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. Mongo login_attempts showed separate docs for 10.79.138.2 and 10.79.138.5 with counts of 3/3 and 4/2, so no single counter reached 5. Repro: POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password 6 times via the public URL; the 6th call returns 401, not 429. Mitigation: ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() or request.client.host.
